Name: Pokemon Eggventure - Follow Me
Author: Parme69
Description:
[size=6][b]Pokémon Eggventure — Follow Me[/b][/size]

[i]Your Pokémon finally follow you across the valley.[/i]

Raise a Pokémon until it earns your trust, and it'll leave behind energy of its type. Bring that energy to Leo's PC at Pierre's shop and trade it for a ring — slip it on, and your Pokémon will follow you anywhere you go.

[size=4][b]What this mod adds[/b][/size]

A companion for [b]every final evolution, every regional form, and every shiny[/b] you raise. Birds and dragons soar above the ground, ghosts and floating creatures levitate at your side, each with its own cast shadow. Everyone else trots faithfully behind you.

Each ring unlocks by raising a Pokémon of its line to five hearts in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49098]Pokemon Eggventure - Day Care[/url]. [b]A whole line opens at once[/b]: raise a single form, and all of its rings become available at the PC.

A ring's price depends on the Pokémon's rarity, and is paid in energy of its type — the same energy your Pokémon produce as they grow.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/8626]Custom Companions[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49098]Pokémon Eggventure — Day Care[/url][/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

Compatible with Stardew Valley Expanded (SVE).
